text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower is appearing on Mayano
Top
Gun's UmaTube livestream. As her
trainer, I come
along to offer support.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, viewers! As you may already
know, we
have a special guest here
today!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm Nishino Flower.
It's a pleasure to be
here!

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text: It's Flower! She's such a cutie!

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Flower!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Seems like everyone's thrilled to have
you here,
Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
W-wow... There are so many people
watching!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's get this party started! I had
my viewers
send in messages for us to
read out today!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Our first message comes from the user 
"DandyFish"! They said, "I messed up big
time at
work and could use some
encouragement."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Copy that, DandyFish! I can see that
you're running on empty, but I'll help
refuel you on
happiness until your tank's
full again!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Go, go, DandyFish! The sky's the limit,
and I'm
your copilot! Let's take off!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aaall right! Your turn, Flower! Go ahead
and give
DandyFish some support!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Me?! O-oh, um... Thank you for writing
in,
DandyFish!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what kind of work you do
or what
kind of mistake you made but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've heard people say that making
mistakes is proof that you're putting
yourself out there and
taking on
something outside your comfort zone.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So I'm sure you only made a mistake
because you
were giving it your all to
finish a tough task.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Just knowing that about you, I can tell
you're a
very hard worker, and I really
respect that about
you!

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text: Omigosh... She's an actual angel!

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm gonna cry. That was like a hug
but with
words.

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text:
I want to receive some encouragement
too!

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text: Spoil me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Flower, you're amazing! I've never seen
the
comment section so full of emotion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The viewers are whipped into a frenzy by
Nishino Flower's genuine compassion,
and the livestream
moves along
swimmingly.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer! What did you think about
my
livestream with Mayano? I hope I
didn't seem
weird...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer! What did you think about
my
livestream with Mayano? I hope I
didn't seem
weird...
choice_data_list: I wanted Flower to cheer me on too.
I found myself wanting Flower to c...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-you really think so? I'm so glad!
choice_data_list: I wanted Flower to cheer me on too.
I found myself wanting Flower to c...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I was thinking that maybe I could
start
doing my own livestreams if there's
a demand for
it. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if I can bring joy to people
through my
encouragement, then why
not?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering the beyond enthusiastic
reception Nishino Flower received
today, letting her do
solo livestreams
might crash UmaTube's servers!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: Showing your running will be the b...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...You're right! I can warm everyone's
hearts with
my running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower and Mayano Top Gun's
archived stream later becomes
something of a holy grail
for those
seeking a source of encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whaaat?! You want me to encourage
you too,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! I'll pull out all the stops to
motivate
you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You always work so hard around the
clock,
Trainer! You're the type of
grown-up I truly
respect!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that you do so much for my
sake inspires
me to work hard, too. So...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You get a gold star!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The immense warmth contained within
Nishino
Flower's heart threatens to
swallow my entire
being whole...
